## Overview

A switch turns one setting on or off, and the change takes effect straight away: trip updates on WhatsApp, price drop alerts, paying with the MMT wallet. There is no Save button behind a switch and no error state. If a choice only applies after the user submits a form, use a Checkbox instead.

A switch has no label of its own. It always sits beside visible text that names the setting, usually as the trailing control of a list row, and that text is its accessible name.

The Cosmos switch is the **Filled** style, set **Switch** (`731:172`). The off track is a solid light grey, the on track is brand, and the thumb is white in every state. It reads like the iOS switch.

> **Outlined backup.** A second style, .Switch / Outlined (`732:191`), was built for comparison and kept as a backup. Its set is hidden on the Switch page, the leading dot keeps it out of the published library, and its `switch/outlined-*` tokens stay in code, but product must not use it. It is documented at the end of this file, under [Outlined backup](#outlined-backup).

Four variant axes drive the set:

- **Selection** is the value: Off or On.
- **State** covers Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus and Disabled.
- **Size** is Medium (the default on mobile and web) or Small (dense web layouts only).
- **Icon** adds a check (on) or close (off) glyph to the thumb, so the value reads without relying on colour.

### When to use something else

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| The choice applies only after the user submits, such as accepting terms | Checkbox |
| Several options can be picked from a list | Checkbox, or filter Chips |
| One option out of several | Radio, or a segmented control |
| The action is a one-off command, such as "Apply coupon" | Button |

### Composition

- **Icon / check** (referenced: `55:14`) is the on glyph and **Icon / close** (referenced: `55:17`) the off glyph. Both are presentational and appear only when `Icon=True`.
- _Decorative children: 1 (Focus ring). It is documented under Structure._

## API

> `State` is design-only except `Disabled`. `Hover`, `Pressed` and `Focus` exist so a mock can show them. In code they are `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible`.

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | The value. Maps to Figma `Selection=On` / `Off`. SwiftUI calls it `isOn`. |
| `onChange` | callback | `(checked) => void` | – | Fires as soon as the switch is toggled. Apply the setting right away. |
| `size` | enum | medium \| small | `medium` | Small is for pointer-first web layouts only. |
| `showIcon` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | Maps to Figma `Icon=True`. Use one value per screen, never mixed in one list. |
| `disabled` | boolean | true \| false | `false` | The switch keeps its value and cannot be toggled. |
| `label` or `labelledBy` | string \| id | – | – | Required. The visible text that names the setting. The switch never renders it itself. |

### Figma-only properties

None. The set has no text, so there is no placeholder copy to override. `Icon` is a variant axis rather than a boolean, so every glyph colour can be bound per state.

The Switch page has no examples frame, by design choice. The examples below describe realistic use.

### Examples

| # | Configuration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Medium, on, in a list row "Trip updates on WhatsApp" / "Booking confirmations and gate changes" | The typical settings row. The whole row toggles the switch. |
| 2 | Medium, off, "Price drop alerts" / "For routes you searched in the last 30 days" | |
| 3 | Medium, off, disabled, "Pay at hotel" / "Not available for this property" | The supporting text says why it is disabled. The row text dims too. |
| 4 | Small, in a 300 wide filter panel: "Free cancellation" on, "Breakfast included" off | Web only. Filters apply as soon as they change. |

---

## Behaviour

- **Immediate effect.** Toggling applies the setting at once. If saving needs the server, flip the switch straight away (optimistic update). If the save fails, flip it back and explain in a Snackbar. Do not block the switch while the request runs.
- **The row is the target.** In a list row, tapping the title, the supporting text or the switch toggles it. Never put a second action in the same row.
- **Placement.** The switch sits at the trailing edge of the row, vertically centred on the text. In right-to-left layouts the whole switch mirrors: off is on the right, and the thumb travels to the left.
- **Label text does not change with the value.** Name the setting ("Price drop alerts"), not the state ("Alerts are off"). The switch shows the state.
- **Disabled** switches keep their value and take the lightest track. Say why nearby, in the supporting text of the row.
- **Size.** Do not mix Medium and Small on one screen. Small is 20 tall and is not for touch.

### Motion (not tokenised yet)

The thumb slides between ends and the track and glyph colours cross-fade, in 150 ms with standard easing, `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`. Hover and pressed colours change in 100 ms linear on web. With reduced motion, the switch changes without animation. The native iOS and Android switches animate on their own, so use their defaults there.

## Structure

### Anatomy

```text
Switch (component set · 731:172) — each variant is the track
├─ Focus ring (rectangle · absolute · Focus variants only) · 4 outside the track on every side
└─ Thumb slot (frame · thumb-size) · pinned to the start when off, the end when on
   └─ Thumb (frame · thumb-size · centred in the slot)
      └─ Glyph (instance · Icon / check or Icon / close · icon-size) · Icon=True only
```

The track is a horizontal auto-layout frame with `switch/thumb-inset` padding on every side. Selection switches the alignment from start to end, which is what moves the thumb.

The focus ring is drawn outside the auto-layout flow, like on Checkbox, so showing focus never moves anything.

### Dimensions

| Property | Medium | Small | Token |
|---|---|---|---|
| Track | 48 × 28 | 36 × 20 | `switch/track-width-md`, `switch/track-height-md`, `switch/track-width-sm`, `switch/track-height-sm` |
| Thumb | 24 | 16 | `switch/thumb-size-md`, `switch/thumb-size-sm` |
| Inset between thumb and track | 2 | 2 | `switch/thumb-inset` |
| Thumb travel | 20 | 16 | track width − thumb − 2 × inset |
| Glyph | 16 | 12 | `switch/icon-size-md`, `switch/icon-size-sm` |
| Radius (track, thumb, ring) | full | full | `switch/radius` |
| Focus ring width / gap to track | 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 | `switch/focus-ring-width`, `switch/focus-ring-offset` |
| Minimum hit area | 48 | 24 | `switch/min-touch-target-md`, `switch/min-touch-target-sm` |

## Color

Token names follow `switch/{part}-{off|on}-{state}`. Focus uses the Default colours and adds the ring. The thumb is `switch/thumb-default` → `bg-fill` #FFFFFF in every state.

### On

| State | Track | Glyph |
|---|---|---|
| Default, Focus | `track-on-default` → `bg-fill-brand` #0067E8 | `icon-on-default` → `icon-brand` #0067E8 |
| Hover | `track-on-hover` → `bg-fill-brand-hover` #0857C5 | `icon-on-hover` → `icon-brand-on-bg-surface-hover` #0857C5 |
| Pressed | `track-on-pressed` → `bg-fill-brand-pressed` #0D4C9B | `icon-on-pressed` → `icon-brand-on-bg-surface-pressed` #0D4C9B |
| Disabled | `track-on-disabled` → `bg-fill-disabled-subtle` #E5E5E5 | `icon-on-disabled` → `icon-disabled` #A1A1A1 |

### Off

| State | Track | Glyph |
|---|---|---|
| Default, Focus | `track-off-default` → `bg-fill-neutral-strong` #D4D4D4 | `icon-off-default` → `icon-tertiary` #737373 |
| Hover | `track-off-hover` → `bg-fill-neutral-strong-hover` #A1A1A1 | `icon-off-hover` → `icon-secondary` #525252 |
| Pressed | `track-off-pressed` → `bg-fill-neutral-strong-pressed` #737373 | `icon-off-pressed` → `icon-secondary` #525252 |
| Disabled | `track-off-disabled` → `bg-fill-disabled-subtle` #E5E5E5 | `icon-off-disabled` → `icon-disabled` #A1A1A1 |

| Element | Token | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Focus ring | `switch/focus-ring` → `border-focus` | #0681FF |

The glyph has one token per state, the way Button icons do. The check glyph tracks the brand track at every state, so glyph and track read as one colour. Hover and pressed use the same roles as the Button text-button icons, which also sit on white. The close glyph cannot match the grey track and still keep 3:1 on the white thumb, so it stays darker than the track and deepens with it. Cosmos has no semantic icon role at `neutral.700`, so pressed repeats `icon-secondary`.

A disabled switch always has the lightest track, `bg-fill-disabled-subtle` #E5E5E5, whether it is on or off. It is one step lighter than the enabled off track, and the thumb position shows the value, as on iOS.

### New semantic roles

- **`color.bg-fill-neutral-strong`**, with `-hover` and `-pressed` steps (#D4D4D4, #A1A1A1, #737373). It is the solid grey for a control part that is present but inactive: the off track here, and the off thumb of the Outlined backup. It deliberately sits below 3:1 (see Contrast), because darker greys read too heavy.
- **`color.bg-fill-disabled`** (#D4D4D4), the middle step between `bg-fill-disabled-subtle` and `bg-fill-disabled-strong`. Only the Outlined backup uses it, for its disabled off thumb. Remove it if the backup is deleted.

## Accessibility

### Contrast

| Pair | Ratio | Required | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Off track #D4D4D4 on white / grey canvas | 1.48 / 1.36:1 | 3:1 (1.4.11) | **Below, accepted.** The thumb position carries the value |
| On track #0067E8 on white / grey canvas | 5.12 / 4.69:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| White thumb on off track #D4D4D4 / #A1A1A1 / #737373 | 1.48 / 2.58 / 4.74:1 | 3:1 | **Below at rest and on hover, accepted**; pressed passes |
| White thumb on on track #0067E8 / #0857C5 / #0D4C9B | 5.12 / 6.60 / 8.32:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Check glyph on the white thumb, #0067E8 / #0857C5 / #0D4C9B | 5.12 / 6.60 / 8.32:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Close glyph on the white thumb, #737373 / #525252 | 4.74 / 7.81:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring #0681FF on white / grey canvas | 3.76 / 3.44:1 | 3:1 | Pass |
| Disabled tracks, thumbs and glyphs | – | – | Exempt: inactive (1.4.11) |

The value never depends on colour alone: the thumb position changes with it, and `Icon=True` adds a glyph for users who want more than position (1.4.1).

### Semantics

| | Web | iOS / VoiceOver | Android / TalkBack |
|---|---|---|---|
| Role | `button role="switch"` with `aria-checked`, or `input type="checkbox" role="switch"` | `Toggle` (SwiftUI) or `UISwitch`, which carry the switch trait | `Switch`, or `Modifier.toggleable(role = Role.Switch)` on the row |
| Name | The row text: a wrapping `label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title. Add the supporting text with `aria-describedby` | The row is one element: `.accessibilityElement(children: .combine)`. VoiceOver reads "Price drop alerts, switch button, off" | `Modifier.toggleable` on the whole row with `mergeDescendants`. TalkBack reads "Off, Price drop alerts, switch" |
| Value | `aria-checked="true"` / `"false"`. Never `"mixed"`: a switch has no third state | Read as "on" / "off" | Read as "On" / "Off" |
| Glyph | `aria-hidden="true"` | Hidden | `contentDescription = null` |
| Disabled | `disabled` on the native control, or `aria-disabled="true"` when it must stay focusable | `.disabled(true)`, read as "dimmed" | `enabled = false` |

**Keyboard (web).** Tab reaches the switch, and Space toggles it. On `button role="switch"`, Enter toggles it too. The focus ring shows on `:focus-visible` only.

**Touch target.** The Medium track is 48 × 28, so pad it to 48 × 48 or, better, make the whole row the target. Small reaches the WCAG 2.5.8 floor of 24 and is not for touch.

---

## Platform mapping

| | Android | iOS | Web |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | A custom composable drawn from the tokens. The Material 3 `Switch` always draws an outlined off track at 52 × 32, so it cannot match the Filled style | `Toggle` with a custom `ToggleStyle` that draws the track and thumb from the tokens. `UISwitch` is fixed at 51 × 31 and only takes tint colours, so it cannot follow these sizes | A `Switch` component rendering `button role="switch"`, with the track and thumb as styled spans |
| Row | `Modifier.toggleable` on the `ListItem`, with the switch as `trailingContent` | The whole `List` row wraps the `Toggle`, with the label as its title | A `label` wrapping the text and the switch |
| Glyph | Drawn inside the custom thumb, coloured per state | Drawn inside the custom thumb | An inline SVG inside the thumb span |

---

## Known gaps

- **The off state sits below 3:1 at rest.** `bg-fill-neutral-strong` is #D4D4D4 by design choice (1.48:1 on white, 1.36:1 on the grey canvas). A passing grey needs a new primitive between `neutral.400` and `neutral.500`, for example #8A8A8A at 3.45:1.
- **No motion tokens.** The transitions above are documented, not tokenised.
- **The focus ring position is geometry.** `switch/focus-ring-offset` is not bound in Figma; the ring binds its width, radius and colour, as on Checkbox and Tab.
- **The hit area is not drawn in Figma.** `switch/min-touch-target-md` and `-sm` exist for code only.
- **No loading state.** Saving is handled optimistically, as described under Behaviour.
- **No dark mode.** All variable collections are single-mode.
- **Not uSpec-generated.** This file is hand-authored next to the Figma build.

## Outlined backup

.Switch / Outlined (`732:191`) is kept, hidden and unpublished, in case the Filled style is revisited. It is not for product use. Every token it alone uses carries the `outlined-` prefix, and its descriptions say "Outlined backup style only". It shares the on track, the thumb, the sizes, the inset, the focus ring and the semantic roles with Filled.

How it differs:

- **Off track** is white with a 2 px inside outline, and the **off thumb** is grey and smaller. It keeps the centre of the full thumb and grows in place when switched on.
- **Start edge.** When off, the thumb slot sits flush with the start edge (`switch/outlined-thumb-inset-off-start`, 0), so the thumb travels 22 (Medium) or 18 (Small).
- **Glyph** keeps one colour per value instead of one per state.

| Off state | Track | Outline | Thumb | Glyph |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default, Focus | `bg-fill` #FFFFFF | `border-strong` #737373 | `bg-fill-neutral-strong` #D4D4D4 | `icon-inverse` #FFFFFF |
| Hover | `bg-fill-hover` #F5F5F5 | same | `bg-fill-neutral-strong-hover` #A1A1A1 | same |
| Pressed | `bg-fill-pressed-strong` #E5E5E5 | same | `bg-fill-neutral-strong-pressed` #737373 | same |
| Disabled | `bg-surface-disabled` #E5E5E5 | `border-disabled-subtle` #D4D4D4 | `bg-fill-disabled` #D4D4D4 | same |

When on, it is the Filled on state, with the glyph on `switch/outlined-icon-on` (`icon-brand`) in every enabled state and `switch/outlined-icon-disabled` when disabled.

| Dimension | Medium | Small | Token |
|---|---|---|---|
| Off thumb, no glyph | 16 | 12 | `switch/outlined-thumb-size-off-md`, `switch/outlined-thumb-size-off-sm` |
| Off thumb, with glyph | 20 | 12 | `switch/outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-md`, `switch/outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-sm` |
| Outline | 2 | 2 | `switch/outlined-border-width` |

Contrast: the #737373 outline passes (4.74:1 on white), so the control stays visible. The grey off thumb (1.48:1 on its track) and the white close glyph on it (1.48:1) do not.

To remove the backup: delete .Switch / Outlined and its showcase frame (`732:190`), every `switch/outlined-*` token, and `color.bg-fill-disabled`.

## Token reference

51 tokens under `component.switch` in `tokens/tokens.json`, mirrored 1:1 as `switch/*` in the Figma `component` collection:

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| Track: `track-on-{default,hover,pressed,disabled}`, `track-off-{default,hover,pressed,disabled}` | 8 |
| Thumb: `thumb-default` | 1 |
| Glyph, per state: `icon-on-{default,hover,pressed,disabled}`, `icon-off-{default,hover,pressed,disabled}` | 8 |
| Focus ring colour: `focus-ring` | 1 |
| Size pairs (`track-width`, `track-height`, `thumb-size`, `icon-size`, `min-touch-target`, each `-sm` and `-md`) | 10 |
| Shared dimensions: `thumb-inset`, `radius`, `focus-ring-width`, `focus-ring-offset` | 4 |
| Outlined backup: `outlined-track-off-*`, `outlined-border-off-{default,disabled}`, `outlined-thumb-off-*`, `outlined-icon-{on,off,disabled}`, `outlined-thumb-size-off-{sm,md}`, `outlined-thumb-size-off-icon-{sm,md}`, `outlined-thumb-inset-off-start`, `outlined-border-width` | 19 |

Platform names follow the standard pipeline: `switch/track-off-default` → `--switch-track-off-default` (CSS) → `CosmosTokens.switchTrackOffDefault` (Swift / Kotlin) → `tokens.switch["track-off-default"]` (TS, the default export of `dist/web/tokens.ts`).
